romans-10-study-notes.overview: This study of Romans 10 examines why Israel rejected God's way of salvation (verses 1-13), the remedy for that rejection (14-17), and its results (18-21), including the message being shared with the Gentiles.

romans-12-study-notes.overview: This study of Romans 12 starts from the fourth "therefore" in Romans, the "therefore" of dedication. It covers three steps of dedication (body, mind, and will as sacrifices to God) and how that shapes relationships with other believers and with enemies.

romans-08-study-notes.overview: This study of Romans 8:18-30 places the passage within the chapter's four spiritual freedoms and focuses on freedom from discouragement. It covers the three groans (creation, believers, and the Holy Spirit), the hope of adoption, and God's perfect plan for those who love Him.
